CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.acquisition_content_evidence_current(p_workspace uuid, p_campaign uuid, p_artifact uuid, p_hash text, p_verification uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.acquisition_evidence_object_access(p_name text, p_upload boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE artifact public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts%ROWTYPE; evidence_role text; stamped timestamptz:=clock_timestamp();
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR auth.jwt()->>'aal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2'
  OR p_upload IS NULL OR p_name IS NULL OR p_name !~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/[0-9a-f]{64}$' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Validate path before UUID casting; use the primary key then exact key equality.
 SELECT * INTO artifact FROM public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts a
 WHERE a.id=split_part(p_name,'/',2)::uuid
  AND p_name=a.workspace_id::text||'/'||a.id::text||'/'||a.expected_sha256;
 IF NOT FOUND OR artifact.created_at>stamped OR artifact.retain_until<=stamped THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 evidence_role:=private.acquisition_role(artifact.workspace_id);
 IF coalesce(evidence_role,'') NOT IN ('owner','admin','operator')
  OR (evidence_role='operator' AND artifact.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.sessions s WHERE s.id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id'
  AND s.user_id=auth.uid() AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>stamped)) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_revocations r
  WHERE r.workspace_id=artifact.workspace_id AND r.artifact_id=artifact.id) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_evidence_policies p
  WHERE p.id=artifact.retention_policy_id AND p.workspace_id=artifact.workspace_id AND p.purpose=artifact.purpose
   AND p.revoked_at IS NULL AND p.valid_from<=stamped AND p.valid_until>stamped) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM storage.buckets b WHERE b.id='acquisition-evidence' AND b.name=b.id
  AND b.public IS FALSE AND b.file_size_limit=10485760 AND b.type='STANDARD' AND b.versioning_status='DISABLED'
  AND b.lifecycle_configuration IS NULL AND b.allowed_mime_types=ARRAY['application/pdf','image/png','image/jpeg','text/plain']) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_upload THEN
  RETURN artifact.created_by=auth.uid() AND storage.allow_only_operation('object.upload')
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_activation WHERE singleton AND enabled)
   AND (
    (artifact.campaign_id IS NOT NULL AND artifact.contract_id IS NULL AND artifact.contract_version IS NULL
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ad_campaigns c WHERE c.workspace_id=artifact.workspace_id
      AND c.id=artifact.campaign_id AND c.acquisition_channel='direct_mail' AND c.status='draft'))
    OR
    (artifact.campaign_id IS NULL AND artifact.contract_id IS NOT NULL AND artifact.contract_version IS NOT NULL
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.deals d JOIN public.acquisition_contract_versions v
       ON v.workspace_id=d.workspace_id AND v.deal_id=d.id AND v.version=d.acquisition_version
      WHERE d.id=artifact.contract_id AND d.workspace_id=artifact.workspace_id
       AND d.acquisition_version=artifact.contract_version AND d.acquisition_status IN ('draft','pending_signature','title_review') AND v.status='draft')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_evidence_upload_slots slot
      WHERE slot.workspace_id=artifact.workspace_id AND slot.actor_id=auth.uid()
       AND slot.campaign_id IS NULL AND slot.contract_id=artifact.contract_id
       AND slot.contract_version=artifact.contract_version AND slot.artifact_id=artifact.id
       AND slot.started_at<=stamped AND slot.expires_at>stamped))
   );
 END IF;
 RETURN storage.allow_any_operation(ARRAY['object.get_authenticated','object.get_authenticated_info']);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.acquisition_evidence_scan_state(p_workspace uuid, p_campaign uuid, p_artifact uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE artifact public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts%ROWTYPE;
 latest public.acquisition_evidence_verifications%ROWTYPE; registry jsonb;
 role_name text; quarantine boolean; current_scan boolean:=false; status_name text; checked timestamptz:=statement_timestamp();
BEGIN
 role_name:=private.acquisition_role(p_workspace);
 IF auth.jwt()->>'role' IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR auth.jwt()->>'aal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2'
  OR coalesce(role_name,'') NOT IN ('owner','admin','operator') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evidence scan access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO artifact FROM public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts
  WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND campaign_id=p_campaign AND id=p_artifact;
 IF NOT FOUND OR (role_name='operator' AND artifact.created_by<>auth.uid()) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evidence scan unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 registry:=private.acquisition_evidence_state(p_workspace,p_campaign,p_artifact);
 -- A later clean scan or re-registration of the same bytes cannot erase detection.
 -- Do not expose another artifact's identity, scan payload or signer information.
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_verifications
  WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND scan_status='detected' AND observation->>'sha256'=artifact.expected_sha256) INTO quarantine;
 SELECT * INTO latest FROM public.acquisition_evidence_verifications
  WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND campaign_id=p_campaign AND artifact_id=p_artifact
  ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1;
 IF latest.id IS NOT NULL AND latest.scan_status='no_detection' AND latest.created_at<=checked THEN
  SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_evidence_verification_keys k
   JOIN public.workspace_memberships m ON m.workspace_id=k.workspace_id AND m.user_id=latest.actor_id
   JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=m.user_id
   JOIN auth.sessions s ON s.id=latest.session_id AND s.user_id=m.user_id
   WHERE k.id=latest.key_id AND k.workspace_id=p_workspace AND k.revoked_at IS NULL
    AND k.valid_from<=checked AND checked<k.valid_until
    AND k.valid_from<=(latest.observation->>'checked_at')::timestamptz
    AND k.scanner_version=latest.observation->>'scanner_version'
    AND k.scan_policy_version=latest.observation->>'scan_policy_version'
    AND m.status='active' AND m.role IN ('owner','admin','operator')
    AND m.updated_at=latest.actor_membership_updated_at AND p.status='approved'
    AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>checked)) INTO current_scan;
 END IF;
 status_name:=CASE WHEN registry->>'status'<>'pending_verification' THEN registry->>'status'
  WHEN quarantine THEN 'quarantined' WHEN latest.id IS NULL THEN 'not_scanned'
  WHEN current_scan THEN 'no_detection_observed' ELSE 'requires_review' END;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('workspace_id',p_workspace,'campaign_id',p_campaign,'artifact_id',p_artifact,
  'status',status_name,'quarantined',quarantine,
  'observation_id',CASE WHEN status_name='no_detection_observed' THEN latest.id ELSE NULL END,
  'preview_authorized',false,'content_approved',false,'execution_authorized',false,'checked_at',checked);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admit_acquisition_evidence_upload(p_attempt uuid, p_workspace uuid, p_campaign uuid, p_artifact uuid, p_purpose text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE stamped timestamptz; chosen smallint; retry_at timestamptz; expiry timestamptz;
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR auth.jwt()->>'aal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2'
  OR coalesce(private.acquisition_role(p_workspace),'') NOT IN ('owner','admin','operator') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evidence upload authority required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_attempt IS NULL OR p_campaign IS NULL OR p_artifact IS NULL OR p_purpose IS NULL
  OR p_purpose NOT IN ('mail_content','mail_destination') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Evidence upload identity required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 -- Across API processes. No client release or early reuse of a reservation.
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('evidence-upload-admission:'||p_workspace::text,0));
 stamped:=clock_timestamp();
 -- Fresh post-wait authority and deadlines; matching phone/email/token claims are insufficient.
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts a
 JOIN private.acquisition_evidence_policies p ON p.id=a.retention_policy_id AND p.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND p.purpose=a.purpose
 JOIN public.ad_campaigns c ON c.id=a.campaign_id AND c.workspace_id=a.workspace_id
 JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id=a.workspace_id
 JOIN public.workspace_memberships m ON m.workspace_id=w.id AND m.user_id=auth.uid()
 JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id=m.user_id
 JOIN auth.sessions s ON s.user_id=profile.id AND s.id::text=auth.jwt()->>'session_id'
 WHERE a.id=p_artifact AND a.workspace_id=p_workspace AND a.campaign_id=p_campaign AND a.purpose=p_purpose
  AND a.created_by=auth.uid() AND a.created_at<=stamped AND a.retain_until>stamped
  AND p.revoked_at IS NULL AND p.valid_from<=stamped AND p.valid_until>stamped
  AND c.acquisition_channel='direct_mail' AND c.status='draft' AND w.status='active'
  AND m.status='active' AND m.role IN ('owner','admin','operator') AND profile.status='approved'
  AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>stamped)
  AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_activation WHERE singleton AND enabled)
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_revocations r WHERE r.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND r.artifact_id=a.id);
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current evidence upload authority required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_evidence_upload_slots WHERE attempt_id=p_attempt) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'A fresh upload attempt is required' USING ERRCODE='23505'; END IF;
 SELECT expires_at INTO retry_at FROM private.acquisition_evidence_upload_slots
  WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND actor_id=auth.uid() AND expires_at>stamped;
 IF retry_at IS NULL THEN
  SELECT n::smallint INTO chosen FROM generate_series(1,2) n WHERE NOT EXISTS(
   SELECT 1 FROM private.acquisition_evidence_upload_slots WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND slot=n AND expires_at>stamped)
   ORDER BY n LIMIT 1;
  IF chosen IS NULL THEN SELECT min(expires_at) INTO retry_at FROM private.acquisition_evidence_upload_slots WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF retry_at IS NULL THEN
  expiry:=stamped+interval '120 seconds';
  INSERT INTO private.acquisition_evidence_upload_slots(workspace_id,slot,actor_id,attempt_id,campaign_id,artifact_id,started_at,expires_at)
   VALUES(p_workspace,chosen,auth.uid(),p_attempt,p_campaign,p_artifact,stamped,expiry)
   ON CONFLICT(workspace_id,slot) DO UPDATE SET actor_id=EXCLUDED.actor_id,attempt_id=EXCLUDED.attempt_id,
    contract_id=NULL,contract_version=NULL,campaign_id=EXCLUDED.campaign_id,artifact_id=EXCLUDED.artifact_id,started_at=EXCLUDED.started_at,expires_at=EXCLUDED.expires_at;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('attempt_id',p_attempt,'workspace_id',p_workspace,'campaign_id',p_campaign,'artifact_id',p_artifact,
  'purpose',p_purpose,'admitted',retry_at IS NULL,'checked_at',stamped,'expires_at',expiry,
  'retry_after_seconds',CASE WHEN retry_at IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE greatest(1,ceil(extract(epoch FROM retry_at-stamped))::integer) END,
  'execution_authorized',false);
END $function$

DECLARE a public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts%ROWTYPE; revoked timestamptz; policy_current boolean;
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR auth.jwt()->>'aal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2'
  OR coalesce(private.acquisition_role(p_workspace),'') NOT IN ('owner','admin','operator') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Contract document access denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO a FROM public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND contract_id=p_contract
  AND contract_version=p_version AND id=p_artifact AND campaign_id IS NULL;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Contract document unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT created_at INTO revoked FROM public.acquisition_evidence_revocations WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND artifact_id=p_artifact;
 SELECT revoked_at IS NULL AND valid_from<=statement_timestamp() AND valid_until>statement_timestamp() INTO policy_current
 FROM private.acquisition_evidence_policies WHERE id=a.retention_policy_id AND workspace_id=p_workspace AND purpose=a.purpose;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('artifact_id',a.id,'workspace_id',a.workspace_id,'contract_id',a.contract_id,'contract_version',a.contract_version,
  'purpose',a.purpose,'expected_sha256',a.expected_sha256,'expected_byte_size',a.expected_byte_size,'media_type',a.media_type,
  'created_at',a.created_at,'retain_until',a.retain_until,'retention_policy_id',a.retention_policy_id,'revoked_at',revoked,
  'status',CASE WHEN revoked IS NOT NULL THEN 'revoked' WHEN a.retain_until<=statement_timestamp() THEN 'expired'
   WHEN policy_current IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN 'policy_review_required' ELSE 'pending_verification' END,
  'bytes_verified',false,'legal_review_approved',false,'execution_authorized',false,'checked_at',statement_timestamp());
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.contract_review_evidence_current(p_workspace uuid, p_contract uuid, p_version integer, p_artifact uuid, p_verification uuid, p_hash text, p_purpose text, p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_artifacts a
  JOIN public.acquisition_evidence_verifications v ON v.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND v.contract_id=a.contract_id
   AND v.contract_version=a.contract_version AND v.artifact_id=a.id AND v.contract_purpose=a.purpose AND v.id=p_verification
  JOIN private.acquisition_evidence_policies policy ON policy.workspace_id=a.workspace_id AND policy.id=a.retention_policy_id
  JOIN private.acquisition_evidence_verification_keys k ON k.workspace_id=v.workspace_id AND k.id=v.key_id
  JOIN private.acquisition_contract_verification_key_scopes ks ON ks.workspace_id=k.workspace_id AND ks.key_id=k.id AND ks.purpose=a.purpose
  JOIN public.workspace_memberships m ON m.workspace_id=v.workspace_id AND m.user_id=v.actor_id
  JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=m.user_id JOIN auth.sessions s ON s.id=v.session_id AND s.user_id=v.actor_id
  WHERE a.workspace_id=p_workspace AND a.contract_id=p_contract AND a.contract_version=p_version AND a.id=p_artifact
   AND a.purpose=p_purpose AND a.expected_sha256=p_hash AND a.created_at<=p_at AND a.retain_until>p_at
   AND policy.purpose=a.purpose AND policy.revoked_at IS NULL AND policy.valid_from<=p_at AND p_at<policy.valid_until
   AND v.scan_status='no_detection' AND v.created_at<=p_at
   AND v.id=(SELECT id FROM public.acquisition_evidence_verifications WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND artifact_id=p_artifact ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1)
   AND k.revoked_at IS NULL AND k.valid_from<=p_at AND p_at<k.valid_until
   AND k.valid_from<=(v.observation->>'checked_at')::timestamptz
   AND k.scanner_version=v.observation->>'scanner_version' AND k.scan_policy_version=v.observation->>'scan_policy_version'
   AND ks.revoked_at IS NULL AND ks.valid_from<=p_at AND p_at<ks.valid_until
   AND ks.valid_from<=(v.observation->>'checked_at')::timestamptz
   AND m.status='active' AND m.role IN ('owner','admin','operator') AND m.updated_at=v.actor_membership_updated_at
   AND p.status='approved' AND (s.not_after IS NULL OR s.not_after>p_at)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_revocations WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND artifact_id=p_artifact)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.acquisition_evidence_verifications WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND scan_status='detected' AND observation->>'sha256'=p_hash))
$function$
